items.title: An lci map into a regular S-scheme forces the map and the target's structure morphism to be Koszul at the image points
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a commutative diagram X -> Y -> S with S locally Noetherian, Y -> S locally of finite type, Y regular, and X -> S lci, the lemma concludes f : X -> Y is lci and Y -> S is Koszul at f(x) for every x — the regular-intermediate splitting law of the Avramov apparatus. The retained proof is written as a three-reference specialization: the chapter's main Avramov comparison theorem (lemma lci-avramov, collected as L16065) relates the Tor-amplitude defects of the three structure maps in a tower over a Noetherian base; feeding it the perfection of Y -> S supplied by the regularity of the target (chapter lemma regular-target-perfect — the regular-over-locally-Noetherian map to a regular scheme is perfect — together with Morphisms, lemma permanence-finite-type to check the finite type bookkeeping) collapses one defect term and outputs both conclusions simultaneously. Retained author proof at lines 18436-18440.
